results.title: From eggshells to paddleboards, the surprising ways Islington is helping the planet
results.description: From paddleboard litter-picking to turning eggshells into useful materials, Nicola Baird celebrates Islington's imaginative approach to tackling climate change.

results.title: Fossil fuel row stalls COP31 climate deal
results.description: COP31 climate talks spilled into Saturday as nations remained deadlocked after a draft deal dropped all mention of fossil fuels, angering the EU and others
